;AUTION : Do not use automatic bleed equipment (risk of foaming of the brake fluid in the hydraulic circuit)


### N.B. : For the bleed operation 2 operators are necessary.
`peugeot_boxer_en_0834a085` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:730 | doc_type:owners_manual
Chock and lift the vehicle on a 2 column lift.

Figure : B2BM0ODD

Couple a transparent pipe onto the bleed valve (1).   
Sink the end of the transparent tube in a container containing brake fluid located lower down than the clutch slave cylinder.

CAUTION : The end of the transparent pipe must be submerged into the brake fluid.

Open the bleed valve (1).   
Action the clutch pedal manually through its entire travel rapidly 7 times.   
Leave the clutch pedal at the lower end of its travel during the last manoeuvre.   
Close the bleed valve (1).   
Allow the clutch pedal to rise to the upper position.   
Fill the brake fluid reservoir to its maximum capacity.   
Open the bleed valve (1).   
Action the clutch pedal manually through its entire travel rapidly 7 times.   
Keep the clutch pedal at the lower end of its travel during the last manoeuvre.   
Close the bleed valve (1).   
Uncouple the transparent pipe.   
Top up the brake fluid level to the MAX. level in the brake fluid reservoir.   
Press the clutch pedal rapidly 40 times.   
Lower the vehicle.   
Start the engine.   
Apply the handbrake.   
Engage a gear. Check that clutch mechanism friction begins at a dimension "A" of 40 mm or more (the dimension (A) is given as a guide).   
Repeat the bleed operations (if necessary).

The gear wheels have HCR (High Contact Ratio) helocoidal teeth. The lubrication of the gear trains and moving plants inside the gearbox is dynamic. The oil taken through openings and ducts on the hollow secondary shafts means :

Better efficiency the transmission of the torque and significantly reduced wear Good manoeuvrability at a low temperature through the use of a multigrade synthetic oil

### 4. Checking the power steering pump
`peugeot_boxer_en_f71cf945` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:793 | doc_type:owners_manual
=ill the power steering fluid reservoir to the maximum level.

N.B. : Power steering fluid : TUTELLA GI/E.

Open the three-way tap [0710-C].   
Turn the steering mechanism from lock to lock several times.   
Top up the power steering fluid to the maximum level.   
Start the engine.   
Check that there are no leaks.

CAUTION : Do not close the three-way tap [0710-C] for longer than 10 seconds

Close the three-way tap [0710-C].

Read the pressure value indicated on the pressure gauge as soon as the fluid stops from escaping. The pressure should be :

114 to 4 bars (2,2 litre engine)   
115 to 5 bars (3 litre engine)

Open the three-way tap [0710-C].   
Stop the engine.   
Pressure not correct : Replace the power steering pump.   
Power steering pump pressure correct : The problem comes from the steering mechanism.

N.B. : After confirming an actual lack of power-assistance (by prior test), change the power steering mechanism.

### 1. Drain and refill
`peugeot_boxer_en_750d0c3a` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:821 | doc_type:owners_manual
Unscrew the power steering reservoir cap .   
Raise the vehicle and support on axle stands, wheels free.

![](images/4913b3f61e1d08a7c24500e179f2b21ff45799ec3d89df88bcdd925adfb01b34.webp)

Figure : B3FP7NUD

Uncouple the low pressure pipe union (1).   
Turn the steering in both directions, from lock to lock.   
Recover the power steering fluid.   
Plug the low pressure pipe union (1).

N.B. : Do not re-use the power steering fluid.


### 2. Refilling
`peugeot_boxer_en_945eaaa6` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:822 | doc_type:owners_manual
Use fresh power steering fluid Oil quality : TUTELLA GI/E.

![](images/ff530fc27bc545d7e82f7c9f21e25ddec0a4b5ec54aa1590703140b17c076184.webp)  
Figure : B3EP19CD

"A" : Power steering fluid level when cold (20 °C).   
"B" : Power steering fluid level when warm (90 °C).   
Fill the power steering fluid reservoir to the maximum level.


### 3. Bleeding
`peugeot_boxer_en_c6bd2154` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:823 | doc_type:owners_manual
N.B. : Return the vehicle to its wheels.

Engine stopped :

Fil the power steering fluid reservoir to the maximum level (If necessary) •Turn the steering in both directions, from lock to lock (3 times minimum) Top up the power steering fluid to the maximum level (If necessary)

engine running :

Wait one minute Top up the power steering fluid to the maximum level (If necessary) Move the steering from lock to lock, until there is no point of resistance

Stop the engine.   
Top up the power steering fluid to the maximum level.   
Check there are no leaks.

The drive shaft nut The tool [1]

### 3. Refitting
`peugeot_boxer_en_46657e28` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:943 | doc_type:owners_manual
Insert the suspension strut into the wheel arch.   
Refit the bolts (17) ; Tighten to 6 ± 2,3 daN.m.   
Position the ball-joint housing (14).   
Refit the bolts (13) ; Tighten to 11,5 ± 0,4 daN.m.

Refit :

The silentblock (16) • The washer (12) The nut (11)

Couple up the steering balljoint (10).   
Refit the nut (9) ; Tighten to 8 ± 0,7 daN.m.   
Refit The drive shaft nut .   
Immobilise the hub from rotation using tool [1].   
Tighten the driveshaft nut to 47,5 ± 4,75 m.daN.   
Remove the tool [1].

![](images/751306e6e8edcb76211a1b3f9e6edb7912b13f21d75011e27b6e63eca23fa9b5.webp)  
Figure : B2FP06MD

Lock each drive shaft nut with the help of tool [3].

N.B. : The flat part "b" of the tool should always face outwards.

CAUTION : The nut collar must be locked in the opposite direction to tightening.

Refit :

The brake caliper (8) The new bolt (7) Pre-coated with a thread-locking product ; Tighten to 3,4 ± 0,2 daN.m

Reposition and reconnect :

The electrical harness (at "a")   
The brake hose   
The clip (6)

The brake pads (see the relevant operation) The front wheel sensor (4) (see the relevant operation) The (5) bolt ; Tighten to 0,8 ± 0,3 daN.m

3.3. Common operations

Return the vehicle to its wheels.

`peugeot_boxer_en_240cda7e` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1007 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : The use of impact wrenches to refit the wheel bolts and wheel antitheft bolts is strictly prohibited.

CAUTION : The wheels are always tightened with dry bolts.

CAUTION : When installig a new steel wheel for the first time, Always double tighten the wheel, t avoid any risk of slackening.

N.B. : Double ttening consist of tenng to the speified torque follwed by slackening then retgtening to the speified torque.

Ensure that the anti-theft wrench is positioned correctly on refiting.

CAUTION : Tighten the wheel bolts using a torque wrench.

, The nut (5) Couple up the steering balljoint (2) (on each side).

Fit the wheels.

### 3.2. Applying the adhesive
`peugeot_boxer_en_e5adac22` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1119 | doc_type:owners_manual
Fit the extruder gun with the mastic mixer assembly.   
Take the nozzle supplied in the glueing kit.   
Cut out the end of the nozzle to a diameter of 8 mm and a height of 13 mm.   
1st case : windscreen (Recovered).   
There is no need to apply primer.   
The bearing face for affixing seal must be perfectly clean.   
Remove any impurities on the shaved seal ; Using a blow gun .   
2nd case : windscreen (New).   
Degrease the glass surround using the product selected from the bonding kit.   
Further primer must be applied fllowing the line of the primer applied during manufacture (Allow to dry for 10 mn).

CAUTION : No more than 8 minutes must elapse between applying the mastic and positioning the glass (For the quicl setting bonding mastics).

Apply the bead of adhesive to the centre of the trace of primer.

Figure : C5CP0A1D

CAUTION : Do not apply stress to the windscreen.

Position a strap on the tools [KIT1-VENT] to keep the windscreen in contact.   
Allow to cure for 30 minutes before handling.   
Check the sealing of the windscreen.

N.B. : Numerous factors can affect the result of a repair.

The most important points to be complied with are the following :

Check for the presence of moisture in the impact Check that the temperature of the window is between 10°C and 30°C Protect the resin from ultraviolet rays   
• Control the amount of pressure during the injection of the impact


### 4.1. Humidity
`peugeot_boxer_en_9e2f0d0f` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1241 | doc_type:owners_manual
N.B. : If moisture is present, dry out the impact using the heating lamp.

CAUTION : Heat the laminated window moderately using the heating lamp as any other excessively strong anc excessively violent heat source may enlarge the impact and crack the laminated window.


### 4.2. Temperature
`peugeot_boxer_en_69e93877` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1242 | doc_type:owners_manual
The ideal temperature for repairing a laminated window is between 10°C and 30°C.

4.3. Ultraviolet rays Repair away from ultraviolet rays.

4.4. Pressure

Follow the pressure level recommendations in the repair manual.

Place a protective cloth on the bonnet for setting down the tools.   
Clean the laminated window around the impact using a dry, lint-free cloth.

N.B. : Do not spray any products onto the impact.

N.B. : Always store the discs in individual plastic bags to avoid contamination. Excessive heat may break the glass.

JUMPER II - C5CM0106P0 - Repair : Scratch on glass

ESSENTIAL : Keep the temperature of the glass under control to prevent it from breaking.

Mixing 5 litres of distilled water with the dose provided permits several repairs of optimum quality. If the polisher bounces on the glass during the operation, increase the level of water and the angle of the polisher slightly.

ESSENTIAL : Use the polisher with extreme care (Splashes of water).


### 4. Scratch
`peugeot_boxer_en_27a4894c` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1249 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : A scratch which can be detected with a fingernail is considered deep and therefore irreparable.

Repairable scratches : Slight scratches Very slight scratches

ESSENTIAL : Follow the repair process using the discs is descending order, blue, orange and white.


### 5. Preparation
`peugeot_boxer_en_03b7ea74` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1250 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/ad78a36e9c9253d9d6ed3120fe512a2c3a0ce7757886d99f03a13e422ecee763.webp)  
Figure : C5CM096D

Examine the scratch (at "a") to be repaired and determine its repair.

N.B. : To see the surface to be worked on more easily, mark the interior of the window using a black marker.

Clean the glass.

Protect the vehicle against slashes of water.


### ESSENTIAL : Use distilled water.
`peugeot_boxer_en_88a76fef` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1251 | doc_type:owners_manual
Fill the water reservoir with the full dose provided for 5 litres of water.   
Pump the coolant reservoir several times to pressurise it.   
The pipe must be connected to the polisher.   
Check that the red water flow valve is in the closed position.

![](images/3001f48f805e4524512a507d6ae4ebd4de6626b22a19d264c7ad8aad9c0ab460.webp)  
Figure : C5CM097D


### 5.1. Polishing
`peugeot_boxer_en_8e04b44a` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1252 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : Too litle water may result in an increase in the temperature of the polishing disc and shorten its service life; too much water slows down the polishing process.

'urn the valve anticlockwise until a few drops of water begin to flow from the centre of the polishing head

ESSENTIAL : Follow the repair process using the discs is descending order, blue, orange and white.

Hold the polisher flat and keep it above the surface to be polished.   
Eliminate the scratch (at "a") ; Using the polisher.   
Polish the area (at "b").   
Clean the glass ; Using a scraper.   
Visually check the progress of the repair.   
After a few minutes of polishing, the scratch begins to disappear.   
Continue polishing until the scratch has disappeared completely.


### 5.2. Final polishing
`peugeot_boxer_en_cdd7d23e` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1253 | doc_type:owners_manual
There are 2 options for the final polishing stage.

1 option :

Use the white disc ; Using the polisher   
Increase the flow and quantity of water   
Hold the polisher flat and keep it above the surface to be repaired   
Polish the area (at "b")   
If the polisher begins to bounce, increase the flow of water   
Continue the final polish, until a satisfactory result is achieved

2 option :

Use the foam disc ; Using the polisher Apply the polishing fluid or powder to the foam disc Add a few drops of water to the foam Hold the polisher flat and keep it above the surface to be repaired Polish the area (at "b") Continue the final polish, until a satisfactory result is achieved • If cloudy marks remain after polishing, Use option 1 to achieve a satisfactory result

### 4. Refitting : Spare wheel
`peugeot_boxer_en_b3647a18` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1255 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/4ace6e8f8d2569eb84d751f5dae7eead5e9b24731ec220a84bc6de8c2da2f136.webp)  
Figure : C5DGYB6D

Place the spare wheel in the winching position, anchor it to the support (7), and secure it with the nut (13).   
Insert the wheel brace onto the extension (9).   
Turn clockwise to raise the wheel, until the wheeli full in place in the calipers under the floor.

CAUTION : Operate the control mechanism (6) only by using the wheel bolt removing tool; do not use electric/pneumatic drivers.

Refit the spare wheel.

ESSENTIAL : Observe the safety and cleanliness recommendations.

### 3.1. Characteristics of the serial number
`peugeot_boxer_en_02e02b4f` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1287 | doc_type:owners_manual
The regulation size of the punches for cold stamping is 7 mm.   
The serial number consists of 17 characters.   
The serial number is always situated on the right-hand section of the vehicle.   
Depending on the vehicle, the serial number may be stamped on one or two lines.   
In all cases, the serial number must be cold stamped onto a structural part.

3.2. Specifications for cold stamping of the serial number (VIN) in service

![](images/eb6eb5c0cfb95a0703ede325ff88ed2b6f65f445678723c073f623ec2e9422d2.webp)

![](images/42156ac3689e3d6004456fa182e8038b3795d76dac51fdb59c0a1a5233e9db9f.webp)

Figure : C4EBONLD

The symbol "a" is obtained by stamping the letter "X" placed horizontally, with a second stamping of the letter "I" superimposed. The cold stamping of a serial number must be carred out by an authorised repairer of the manufacturer's marque.

### TECHNICAL NOTE : BLEEDING THE BRAKE SYSTEM
`peugeot_boxer_en_3b07fab8` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1299 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : The use of DOT4 brake fluid for the brake circuits is compulsory.

CAUTION : During the bleeding operation : Keep the fluid topped up in the reservoir and complete it.

N.B. : Use only clean fluid free from bubbles. Avoid any introduction of impurities into the hydraulic system.


### 1. Bleeding the primary braking circuit
`peugeot_boxer_en_85a9dcc9` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1300 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : Do not switch on the ignition at any time during the operation.

N.B. : Bleed the primary circuit until clean, non-foaming brake fluid is obtained.

There are 2 procedures for bleeding the primary brake circuit.

1.1. Bleeding the primary braking circuit (With the bleeding device) Bleed the circuit following the instructions for use of the equipment.

1.2. Bleeding the primary braking circuit (without brake bleeding equipment)

N.B. : Two operators are necessary.

Couple a transparent tube on the bleed screw .   
Press the brake pedal slowly.   
Open the bleed screw .   
Hold the pedal fully down.   
Close the bleed screw .   
Allow the brake pedal to return naturally.   
Repeat the operation until the fluid running out is clean and free from air bubbles.   
Proceed in the same way for the other wheels.

N.B. : Check that the wheels rotate freely when the parking brake is released .


### 1.3. Checking : Bleeding the primary braking circuit
`peugeot_boxer_en_577ac7c8` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1301 | doc_type:owners_manual
At the end of the bleed programme, check and top up, if necessary, the brake fluid level.   
Check the travel of the brake pedal (no extension).   
If the travel is long and spongy, repeat the bleed procedure.   
Start the engine.   
Check the travel of the brake pedal (no extension) ; Road test the vehicle (if necessary).   
If brake pedal travel is not correct ; Bleed the secondary brake circuit.


### 2. Bleed the secondary brake circuit
`peugeot_boxer_en_89c6576d` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1302 | doc_type:owners_manual
Bleeding of the secondary braking circuit is done with a diagnostic tool.   
This procedure is only carried out if the primary brake circuit has been bled.   
Continue the procedure for bleeding of the hydraulic circuit as defined by the diagnostic tool.   
At the end of the bleed programme, check and top up, if necessary, the brake fluid level.   
Check the brake pedal travel (no extension), otherwise repeat the bleeding procedure.

1. Brake disc - Brake drum - Brake pads - Brake shoes Refer to the method  "Checking : Front brake disc - Rear brake disc - Rear brake drum - Brake pads - Brake shoes"


### N.B. : Engine idling.

### 4. Checking of the brake fluid
`peugeot_boxer_en_7251d42c` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1304 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : Brake fluid is highly corrosive to paintwork. If any is projected onto the bodywork, clean the surface immediately.


### 4.1. Tooling

### 4.2. Checking
`peugeot_boxer_en_f47bcdcf` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1306 | doc_type:owners_manual
Remove the brake fluid reservoir filter.

ESSENTIAL : Any contamination of the brake fluid is forbidden. The brake fluid should be clear and free from sediments or floating substances.

Check the fluid, following the instructions provided by the equipment supplier.

JUMPER I - B3FB011YPO - Checking and adjusting values : Braking system

![](images/87e9d35727abcd814f51add9c9dd09e2e83dbaf8443b674cfa319dc2be323579.webp)

N.B. If the value checked is lower than the value for the "minimum humidity" boiling point, or within a tolerance of+ % of this value, replace the brake fluid (See the corresponding operation).

ESSENTIAL : Use only approved and recommended hydraulic fluids.

N.B. : The fluids DOT3, DOT4 and DOT5.1 are compatible.

CAUTION : The fluid DOT5 is not compatible with DOT3, DOT4 and DOT5.1.

### 3. Front brake disc
`peugeot_boxer_en_520e2580` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1315 | doc_type:owners_manual
Check the tightening torques of the wheels.   
Raise and support the vehicle on a 2 -post lift.

3.1. Checking the brake disc run-out (wheel fitted) (First possibility)

![](images/855907217a98bfb46e6366cde40550fccfda6e6b02527e840507743ba3533fb7.webp)  
Figure : B3FD05CD

Fix :

The assembly [0805-BZ], [0805-L] on the damper The dial gauge [2437-T] on the tool [0805-L]

Place the tip of the dial gauge [2437-T] in contact 10 mm from the periphery of the brake disc (the tip under the action o the spring).

| CAUTION : To check the front brake disc run-out, turn the disc by means of the driveshaft.

Carry out :

A dial gauge zero reset A full turn of the brake disc

Permissible brake disc assembly run-out on the hub : Less than 0,05 mm.

3.2. Checking the brake disc run-out (wheel fitted) (Second possibility)

![](images/01ea11c15079d815627cff82c359a254960db8049b9fd113e2ad70af4fbab741.webp)  
Figure : B3FD05DD

Fix the magnetic support on the lower suspension arm.   
Fix the dial gauge [2437-T] on the magnetic support .   
Place the tip of the dial gauge [2437-T in contact 10 mm from the periphery ofthe brake disc (the tip under the action o the spring).

CAUTION : To check the front brake disc run-out, turn the disc by means of the driveshaft.

Carry out :

A dial gauge zero reset A full turn of the brake disc

Permissible brake disc assembly run-out on the hub : Less than 0,05 mm.

.3. Checking the variation in the thickness of the brake disc (Wheel removed) (First possibility)

![](images/f897a6f2cd78ff19daebb7f53d393698f8a4fe2b1b516f1fa73e0d294a8fd27f.webp)  
Figure : B3FD05ED

Refit and tighten the wheel bolts fited with the tool [0805-D].

Fix :

The assembly [0805-BZ], [0805-L] on the damper The dial gauge [2437-T] on the tool [0805-K]

Loosen the tool [0805-K] (at "a").   
Place the tip of the dial gauge [2437-T] in contact 5 mm from the periphery of the brake disc (the tip under the action of the spring).

CAUTION : To check the variation in the thickness of the front brake disc, turn the brake disc by means of the driveshaft.

Carry out :

A dial gauge zero reset A full turn of the brake disc

Permissible variation in the thickness of the brake disc over the same circumference 0,01 mm.

3.4. Checking the variation in the thickness of the brake disc (Wheel removed) (Second possibility)

![](images/8c8ab2905d5eec24e48bbc9fd352b69e0d33ca31e8d8f8caf3622dc6b8c256c5.webp)  
Figure : B3FD05FD

Check the variation in the thickness over the circumference of the brake disc at eight points 5 mm from the periphery of the brake disc ; Using a micrometer (Capacity: 0 - 50 mm). Permissible variation in the thickness of the brake disc over the same circumference 0,01 mm.

3.5. Checking the thickness of the front brake disc (wheel removed)

![](images/ec3f9fd5b4cb9faad580a36549742b3020df8c06c60fe84064d1b3a55d1eb27c.webp)

Measure the thickness of the brake discs on the friction surfaces ; Using a micrometer (Capacity: 0 - 50 mm).   
See the table below.

Figure : B3FD05FD   
![](images/94ede61f5954868bf847503ede5f10067a67b8e57cbbbfc56ea743f0c22473ff.webp)

Figure : B3FD05ID

Check the tightening torque of the driveshaft nut.   
Use an abrasive cloth to clean the contact surface of the brake hub/disc.

### 2. Preliminary operation
`peugeot_boxer_en_bc70845d` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1318 | doc_type:owners_manual
Untighten the rear wheel bolts.   
Raise and support the vehicle, with the rear wheels hanging free.   
Remove the rear wheels.

![](images/dbb63173a42cf527d8bfbf01b0e23cf3a01af69a47188add4e39aa906c54e294.webp)  
Figure : B3FP7KND

Remove :

The rear brake pads (see the relevant operation) The bolts (1)

Move aside and suspend the brake caliper (2).

3. Checking the thickness

![](images/539d3bcbe3757cd869f4e79c9ea52f87885b8c6d2a877a458831e529117bbb8a.webp)  
Figure : B3FP7KPD

Use a 0/50 mm micrometer.   
Max. thickness variation on one circumference = 0,025 mm .   
Nominal thickness : 15,9/16,2 mm .   
Min. permissible thickness (wear) : 14,2 mm .   
Always replace the discs that are not as thick as the value shown.   
In the case of damage or deep scratches, the surfaces of the disc may be ground.   
Minimum permitted thickness after grinding : 14,55 mm .

4. Checking the run-out

![](images/ec7b082be4cd9a485bf5eef7be0366c5c4742997fb263d38321def5aac83bee7.webp)  
Figure : B3FP7KQD

Fix the magnetic support [1] on the spring leaf.   
Attach the dial gauge [2] to the magnetic bracket [1].   
The brake disc run-out check is carried out at approximately 2 mm from the outside diameter.   
Turn the brake disc by a full rotation.   
Maximum run-out = 0,030 mm .

5. Brake disc inside diameter check

![](images/5a9eab6929977d63c8347727a06e6f0c6d75b877c0a0765c375bd2644965f76a.webp)  
Figure : B3FP7K7D

Remove :

The bolts (3) The rear brake disc

![](images/81355c4f828a30a84b6e68f10d4f6f595213a47f64095bc9669edef8a8525ed5.webp)

Figure : B3FP7KRD

A : Disc brake bore diameter : Nominal diameter : 172/172,15 mm Maximum permitted diameter after wear : 173 mm

Brake shoe lining : Min. permissible thickness = 1,5 mm .

### 3. Bleeding the brake system
`peugeot_boxer_en_cae96cf1` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1394 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : During the bleeding operation : Keep the fluid topped up in the reservoir and complete it. Use new brake fluid only.

Bleed the primary brake circuit during a conventional operation. Bleed the secondary brake circuit in the following cases :

Venting the secondary brake circuit Starting the pump supply to the electrovalves

![](images/0c465f000db9ff83a9d6251d00bd3a4588538a5b30ca7a05ed519f651fc21865.webp)  
Figure : B3FP7N9D

front brake caliper : bleed screw(s) (2).

![](images/323bdee1287d295773150a98c380238699af19ef3b25a1280b27e2213eb7e9fe.webp)  
Figure : B3FP7NAD

rear brake caliper : bleed screw(s) (3).

3.1. Bleeding the primary braking circuit

CAUTION : The ABS system must not be in operation during the bleeding procedure.

Use a bleed tool approved by the manufacturer.

![](images/2495057cfcf734072745d8e070b168fa5c1635aeee466c5e4470856770d22721.webp)  
Figure : B1BPRWAD

Connect the bleeding apparatus [/] on the brake fluid reservoir . Set the pressure of the equipment to 2 bars. Bleeding order :

• RH rear • Left hand front • Left hand rear , Right hand front

![](images/13391e0e6c576058d964c2b512169730f8dd8d08f4fe695abf8bc06ec365c82f.webp)  
Figure : B3FP7NBD

CAUTION : Proceed bolt by bolt in the order shown.

Perform the following operations :

Couple a transparent pipe (4) to the bleed screw   
Submerge the other end of the tube into a clean receptacle   
Open the bleed screw   
Wait for the liquid to flow without air bubbles   
Close the bleed screw Remove the bleeding equipment .   
Check the brake fluid level (between the "MIN" level and the "MAX" level).   
If necessary, fill with approved and recommended synthetic brake fluid.

CAUTION : Any operation which may cause the pump to start or energize electrovalves is to be avoided (the systen has been pre-filled and bled).


### 3.2. Bleed the secondary brake circuit (ABS/ESP hydraulic block)
`peugeot_boxer_en_955ecb09` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1395 | doc_type:owners_manual
N.B. : The equipment to be bled is always connected to the brake fluid reservoir.

Select a diagnostic tool.   
Connect the diagnostic tool.   
From the screen of the diagnostic tool, select the menu : "ABS PURGE".   
Follow the instructions on the diagnostic tool.   
Bleed the brakes observing the order indicated (ABS type bleeding operation).   
At the end of the bleed programme, check and top up, if necessary, the brake fluid level.   
Check the brake pedal travel (no extension), otherwise repeat the bleeding procedure.

### 1. Recommended tools
`peugeot_boxer_en_54ccb9c1` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1691 | doc_type:owners_manual
Glazing consumable  .

![](images/50b2cfc8de447a3fd5f49ea51116e2a77992a30c05083565c33ae4227d8c6aff.webp)  
Figure : E5AP2ZQD

[1] Bonded windows removal kit (-).1354. Composition of the toolkit :

[1a] Guide roller device   
•[1b] Awl [1c] Guiding roller [1d] Square section cutting wire   
[1e] handle [2] electric knife.   
[3] shovel blade N° 146.

![](images/aa40f3eb23cccdeb6862b9dacb0ce99221561fe1271af42f83717e57b36996d0.webp)  
Figure : E5AP2ZRD

![](images/5f00cc8358de5b09a3d99b966ff84c0c3e09d46ce003c766151bd699d3f358cb.webp)

[4] Pneumatic gun (For one part cartridge).

[5] Electric gun (For two-part cartridge).

![](images/d6eb1eb18dd517d75cb76c3bf52dd9957401b8618c6e048dea9f6b73b03996de.webp)  
Figure : E5AP2ZTD

[6] Articulated suction pads (Part number 9776.Y0).

2. Removing

![](images/a67d6705b117fd01209525cc7064314bc1908857a820acb6a1416391fc07d854.webp)  
Figure : C4BMOERD

N.B. : If the window is to be reused, align it and affix adhesive tape (1)(at "a").

Unplug : The 2 de-icing connectors (Rear door window).

![](images/43fefd4ef91084ee11b19edaf8537dd013b2d645be10ef50260a08c18dd74610.webp)  
Figure : C4BM0ESD

JUMPER Il - C4BGo10SP0 - Removing - refiting : Hinged rear door glass

Install the handles [1e] at each end of the cutting wire [1d].   
Pass the cutting wire [1d] as indicated on the diagram (Behind the window).

CAUTION : 2 operators are necessary to carry out the following operations.

Cut the bead of adhesive by means of a to-and-fro movement of the cutting wire [1d].   
When cutting, the indexing pins must be cut.

N.B. : The indexing pins are not necessary for refitting.

Remove : The rear door window (2) ; Using the double hinged suction cups [6].

3. Cleaning

3.1. Preparation : Rear door window

Reuse of the rear door window :

Fit the electric knife [2] with the blade [3] Remove the adhesive sealing bead • Remove any dust using a clean cloth

CAUTION : Only apply the primer to the zones laid bare .

Fitting of a new rear door window :

Degrease the edge of the glass with the degreaser Apply the glass primer provided in the bonding kit part number "A3"

CAUTION : Only apply the primer to the zones laid bare .


### 3.2. Preparation of the aperture
`peugeot_boxer_en_75785cc9` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1692 | doc_type:owners_manual
On the remains of the bead of sealing adhesive :

Fit the electric knife [2] with the blade [3] , Remove the adhesive sealing bead • Remove any dust using a clean cloth

On the new component :

Degrease the aperture Apply the metal primer provided in the bonding kit part number "A3" 0   
Allow to dry for 10 mn


### 4. Refitting
`peugeot_boxer_en_923dd127` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1693 | doc_type:owners_manual
4.1. Reuse of the rear door window

![](images/ebf4e92260398b4631c8922e4655e151379d29af48a114f47ace3e47ac58d0d3.webp)  
Figure : C5CM01XD

"A" = 12 mm .   
"B" = 8 mm .   
Cut the nozzle in triangular section to obtain a bead of sealing adhesive "B" wide and "A" deep.

ESSENTIAL : Always replace : The faulty seals.

Apply a bead of sealing adhesive to the periphery of the rear door window (2) (using tools [4] or [5]) (at "").

ESSENTIAL : Use of the two part product: the time for fitting the window on the vehicle and the start of extrusion of the sealing adhesive is 5 minutes.

Refit the rear door window :

Using the double hinged suction cups [6] Using adhesive tapes (1)

Press lightly on the periphery of the rear door window (2).   
Clean the rear door window and its surround.

4.2. Fitting of a new rear door window

![](images/5b8dd70ce3ac6f28b03b8987b380ee6a4591a5e7eee8edd59a3cc5968c006d3f.webp)  
Figure : C4BMOETD

Test fit the rear door window (2).   
Position the adhesive strips (1).   
Cut the tape ( as "a").   
Remove : The rear door window (2).   
Apply a bead of sealing adhesive to the periphery of the rear door window (2) (at "b").

ESSENTIAL : Use of the two part product: the time for fitig the window on the vehicle and the start of extrusion of the sealing adhesive is 5 minutes.

Refit the rear door window :

Using the double hinged suction cups [6] Using adhesive tapes (1)

Press lightly on the periphery of the rear door window (2).   
Clean the rear door window and its surround.

ESSENTIAL : Observe the vehicle immobilisation time following fiting of the windscreen recommended by the suppliers of the products used.

Continue the fitting operations in the reverse order to removal.   
Check the sealing of the rear door window (2).   
Clean the rear door window and its surround.   
Check the electrical operation of the equipment.

Figure : C5CP09MD

Pass the awl [1b] through the bead of adhesive, from the inside towards the outside (At "a").   
Thread the cutting wire [1d] into the awl [1b] and pass it towards the inside.   
Leave a sufficient length to permit fixing of the handles [1e].   
Install the handles [1e] at each end of the cutting wire [1d].

![](images/aa1eedca54272fa041815af1e8811fd95ae256174d62f426a9f1f17dfd748694.webp)

Figure : C5CP09ND

Remove the quarterlight ( 2) ; Using tool [4].


### 3. Refitting
`peugeot_boxer_en_1b5b3b3c` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1757 | doc_type:owners_manual
3.1. Preparation of the flange and fixed window glass

To the electric knife [2] fit the blade [3] no. 146.   
Shave the beads of adhesive on the fixed window glass and the flange.   
Touch up with anti-corrosion product.   
Degrease the flange using the product selected from the adhesive kit.   
Allow to dry for 10 mn.


### 3.2. Applying the adhesive
`peugeot_boxer_en_79f37b6a` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1758 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/4c787bd9febe3504ae4ffbb8fcd80e22dcaaa902e2590e4664ba570b4cef1dd3.webp)  
Figure : C5CP09PD

Place the mastic mixer assembly into the gun [5].   
Take the nozzle supplied in the glueing kit.   
Cut the nozzle to 8,0 mm dia. at 12 mm from the tip.   
1st case : The fixed window (Reused).   
There is no need to apply primer.   
Remove any impurities on the shaved seal ; Using a blow gun .   
2nd case : The fixed window (New).   
Degrease the surround of the glass with the products chosen from the bonding kit. The glass (2) is supplied pre-coated with primer .   
Further primer must be applied following the line of the primer applied during manufacture as "") (Allow to dry for 10 mn).

ESSENTIAL : No more than 8 minutes must elapse between applying the mastic and positioning the glass (For the quick setting bonding mastics).

Apply the bead of adhesive to the centre of the trace of primer ( as "c").

![](images/df5bf35b79e25054d88137a0741b96bb874abe8d20303004c553f22bde524665.webp)  
Figure : C5CP09QD

Position the fixed window glass ; Using the guides (3).   
Refit the guide fixings (1) to keep the glass in contact.   
Retain the glass in position ; Using tool [6].   
Allow to cure for 30 minutes before handling.   
Check : Check the sealing of the quarterlight by running water over it.   
Proceed in the reverse order to removal.

### REPAIR : ELECTRICAL HARNESSES
`peugeot_boxer_en_5729b771` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1801 | doc_type:owners_manual
The aim of this document is to define the rules for carrying out repairs or work on the electrical harnesses. This document consists of 2 main parts :

The first part describes the general repair methods The second part describes the circumstances of use of these methods in relation to the failures detecte


### 1. Recommendations prior to carrying out the operation
`peugeot_boxer_en_119115e8` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1802 | doc_type:owners_manual
The repairs must only be carried out by trained and authorised personnel.

ESSENTIAL : Disconnect the battery before carring out any repairs or work on an electrical harness (electric battery ancilaries battery, traction battery, etc.).

ESSENTIAL : Take into account the manufacturer's instructions before carring out any work on the pyrotechnic functions (available on the computer equipment or on the marque's technical information internet site.


### 2. Tooling
`peugeot_boxer_en_e70a1a9a` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1803 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/1cca0ec907d308d5edc4fc4928a4db6748ca7a98dc7c841da708387a5f14bb38.webp)

![](images/5ff563a9665c8952d9b1d806427667472873834045c7f6464e830c858003de8c.webp)


### 3.1. Usable wire
`peugeot_boxer_en_175889f7` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1804 | doc_type:owners_manual
A wire is usable if is length i suficient to permit repair without causing any tensile stress which could alter the sealing the connection, the crimping resistance or result in a break over time (too taut).

N.B. : The wire is usable if its graspable length is more than 30 mm.


### 3.2. Unusable wire
`peugeot_boxer_en_cf3e8653` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1805 | doc_type:owners_manual
A wire is unusable i its length is not suficient to permit repair without causing tensile stress which could alter the sealin! of the connection or result in a break over time (too taut). A wire is unusable if it is stripped, pulled out, crushed over a considerable length or burnt.

N.B. : The wire is unusable if its graspable length is less than 30 mm.


### 4. General rules
`peugeot_boxer_en_620e43f2` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1806 | doc_type:owners_manual
General rules to be heeded :

The repairs must only be carried out by trained and authorised personnel   
•After repair, all of the electrical functions affected by the harness must be checked   
The connection of 2 conductors by tin soldering is prohibited (rigidity, breakage)   
•The optical fibres and the screened wires must always be replaced if they are bent or broken   
After analysing the fault, eliminate its cause   
The twisted wires can be repaired

ESSENTIAL : Take into account the manufacturer's instructions before carrying out any work on the pyrotechnic functions (available on the computer equipment or on the marque's technical information internet site.

ESSENTIAL : Allrepairs or work on electrical harnesses are carried out with the battery disconnected Including the service battery if present).


### 5.1. Method for checking a wire
`peugeot_boxer_en_902bd86b` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1807 | doc_type:owners_manual
The aim of the wire checking method is to determine whether the repair can be carried out directly on the damaged wire or whether part of the wire must be replaced.

A wire is declared unusable in the following cases :

The wire is not of suficient length to permit repair without causing traction stresses which could alter the sealing of the connection or breakage over time (too taut)   
The wire is stripped, pulled out or crushed over a considerable length   
The wire is burnt   
In the case of a wire leaving an overmoulded connector, f the remaining usable length of wire is lessthan 30 mm

N.B. : In other cases, the wire is declared usable.


### 5.2. Method for selecting a wire
`peugeot_boxer_en_87e2486c` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1808 | doc_type:owners_manual
If a wire is unusable, the choice of the new wire to be used to carr out the repair must conform to the follwing characteristics :

Cross-section of the wire Colour of the sleeve

ESSENTAL : The cross-section of the wire must be equal to or larger than the initial cross-section, but never smaller.

N.B. : Depending on certain factors, a larger wire cross-section may cause interference or even a reduction in current.

It is compulsory for an earth cable to be green and yellow.   
The other supply or information cables can be of a different colour.

N.B. : Favour the use of a cable of the same colour for the repair.


### 5.3. Method for stripping a wire
`peugeot_boxer_en_db0914cf` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1809 | doc_type:owners_manual
fer cuttin the wire, strip it without cutting the strands using approved wire strippers and observing the following length

### 5.4. Method for tin soldering
`peugeot_boxer_en_7f61e7fb` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1810 | doc_type:owners_manual
Thestrengthening of a faulty crimp (electrical resistance too high) by tin soldering is permited, observing the following procedure.

Tools required :

Soldering iron with clean bit Tin 0,7 mm (60% tin 40% lead) with soldering flux without halogen

Method of operation :

Melt a little tin on the iron bit   
Apply the iron bit under the crimp, the crimp wings must be visible   
Apply the tin wire to the copper strands at the end of the crimp (Soldering consumption approximately 3 mm)

N.B. : The times indicated are only valid for wires with a cross-section of 0,35 to 0,6 mm². For larger cross-sections increase the time by 2 to 3 seconds.

CAUTION : It is important not to apply too much ti (risk of stifening of the wire to avoid damaging the wire insulatior and the single-wire seals.


### 5.5. Method for unclipping a contact
`peugeot_boxer_en_1d80151a` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1811 | doc_type:owners_manual
ESSENTIAL : In extremely cold temperatures, the vehicle must be moved into a heated area and left to return to a temperature of approximately 20 °C before any work is carried out.

The contact must only be unclipped using the unclipping tool which is part of the approved kit and in accordance with instructions included.

CAUTION : Take care not to damage the seals, the contact cell, or the contacts to guarantee the sealing of th connector on refitting.

### 5.9. Simple repair (1 Heat-shrink sleeve )
`peugeot_boxer_en_44c47b9b` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1813 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : To restore an electrical connection with a heat-shrink sleeve, use only the tools and items in the approvec kit.

N.B. : Allow approximately 90 seconds for pre-heating of the hot air generator, one minute heating time depending o the cross-section of the wires and 3 minutes for cooling of the hot air generator.

![](images/8173542e31d48e0467384638ab5ac687cba000468bbad88f1f82ac38837702d8.webp)  
Figure : D6AM03TD

Method of operation (Applicable for a repair of 1 or more wires) :

Remove any covering from the wire (tape, sleeve, etc.) Cut and strip the end of each wire to be repaired ; Using the wire strippers

![](images/b217e71c2db7ae7c464a9691b99b4a550bef961dcf01554c3b013aad819f2ea2.webp)  
Figure : D6AM03UD

"A" Engage the stripped end of the 2 respective wires in the heat-shrink sleeve, twisting them.   
"B" Support the 2 wires and assemble them by heating the sleeve ; Using the hot air generator (seetable below). Sideways movement of the hot air generator may be necessary to obtain uniform heating of the heat-shrink sleeve.   
Put the contact in place in the connector.   
Visually analyse the condition of the contact.   
Insert the contact in its cell.   
Gently pull on the wire to check that the contact is locked.   
Restore the covering of the wire to guarantee protection at least identical to the existing protection.

![](images/72ca5b5b5165b14262c7cd845d096c1aad556364d4718423d0eefc8dc9b971de.webp)

![](images/c51607bc021ab19a587b65be80b3c9e171cd057f06b48b6c2bb749877750cef1.webp)  
Figure : D6AM03VD

N.B. : If the routing of the harness is modified, the harness must be clipped.

CAUTION : The tracks of a connector which are not connected electrically to the vehicle's harness must be fited wit a connection wire and have an end cap fited using the hot air generator.

CAUTION : If the repair requires the use of several heat-shrink sleeves, take care to stagger them to retain a minima volume.

5.10. Repair using additional wires (2 heat-shrink sleeves), wire unusable

![](images/cd70ebcdbd8934433b7ddfcb43972db3b0a4612aff30b72b3040b67f7db4de59.webp)  
Figure : D6AM03WD

The heat-shrink sleeves must be chosen according to the cross-section of the wire to be repaired :

Red sleeve : Wire between 0,35 mm2 and 1 mm2   
Blue sleeve : Wire between 1 mm2 and 3 mm2   
•Yellow sleeve : Wire between 3 mm2 and 5 mm2

N.B. : Crimp a heat-shrink sleve using the tools and items in the connection repair kit f the repair requires the use several heat-shrink sleeves, stagger them to retain a minimal volume.

Position the wires coming from one side in one sleeve and those coming from the other side in another sleeve taking care that the wires do not move away from each other. To make it easier to insert the wires in the heat-shrink sleeve, turn the heat-shrink sleeve slightly. Heat the sleeve using the hot air generator until the tin core melts and the surplus adhesive appears.

5.11. Method for applying a stitch weld sleeve

![](images/da014e4a7045ce9e7336f36c43911f426549d414f86ffe9b2035b136da18bc9e.webp)  
Figure : D6AM03XD

The heat-shrink sleeves must be chosen according to the cross-section of the wire to be repaired :

Red sleeve : Wire between 0,35 mm2 and 1 mm2   
Blue sleeve : Wire between 1 mm2 and 3 mm2   
•Yellow sleeve : Wire between 3 mm2 and 5 mm2

N.B. : Crimp the heat-shrink sleeve using the toos and items in the connection repair kit If the repair requires the us of several heat-shrink sleeves, stagger them to retain a minimal volume.

Position the wires coming from one side in one sleeve and those coming from the other side in another sleeve taking care that the wires do not move away from each other.

N.B. : Turn the heat-shrink sleeve slightly to insert the wires in the sleeve.

Heat the sleeve using the hot air generator until the tin core melts and the surplus adhesive appears. Approximately 90 seconds must be allowed for pre-heating of the gun, 1 minute for heating according to the crosssection of the wires and 3 minutes for cooling of the gun.


### 5.12. Method for restoring the covering
`peugeot_boxer_en_1c2d376e` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1814 | doc_type:owners_manual
In order to restorethe harness covering, guarantee protection at least identical to the existing protection. If modifications are made to the routing, guarantee a minimum distance of 10 mm between the harness and its environment.

-or the taped harnesses, place the repaired part flush against the body of the harness and tape the whole using adhesive tape.

In the case of plastic sleeves, place the repaired part flush against the body of the harness then replace the sleeving

5.13. Method for selecting a protector

Mechanical protection : The mechanical protection is provided using a split spiral sleeve (E.g.: Engine compartment, Wheel arch). Thermal protection : The thermal protection is provided using a high temperature split spiral sleeve (E.g.: Near to the

exhaust in the engine compartment).

Joise protection : The noise protection is provided using a sound deadening sleeve during reworking requiring simple o nechanical protection (E.g. : Passenger compartment, Tailgate).


### 5.14. Restoring the covering
`peugeot_boxer_en_277145f9` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1815 | doc_type:owners_manual
In the case of changes to the routing, a distance of 10 mm minimum must be guaranteed between the harness and its surroundings. A positioning device is compulsory to guarantee the positioning and orientation.   
Taped strands : Place the repaired part fush against the body of the harness and tape the whole using adhesive tape. Sleeved strands : Place the repaired part fush against the body of the harness then put the sleeving back in place. Closed sleeves : Avoid cutting the closed sleves in order to permit passage of the wire, otherwise place the repaired wire on top with appropriate covering.   
Open sleeves : It is compulsory to tape the openings after work.

5.15. Method for repairing the earth points

N.B. : In all cases, check the condition of the earth terminal contact/support/nut or bolt surface and clean it.

Several solutions are recommended.

ioldered square nut with broken self-tapping bolt or the thread of which is damaged :

If the bolt can be extracted, remove it, driland tap to M using a new M8 bolt then apply a tightening torque of 1 Nm ± 3 Nm   
If there is another earth nut nearby, extend the earth wire to reach this earth point, taking care to create a drip channel loop, Apply a tightening torque of 12 Nm ± 2 Nm

Stud which is badly soldered (TUCKER stud), broken or the thread of which is damaged :

If the stud soldering has failed, re-solder the old stud by brazing If the thread is damaged or the bolt is broken, solder a new stud by brazing

In the 2 cases of soldering, apply the method below :

Place a fire extinguisher near the work area   
Strip the location at which the pin is to be soldered   
Rotary sand the soldering location   
Solder the stud or the pin using the gun provided for this purpose   
Apply anticorrosion protection   
Put the removed components back in place

Soldered square nut with slackened self-tapping bolt :

If the M6X100 self-tapping boltis simply slack, retighten the bolt applying a tightening torque of 12 Nm ± 2 Nm Ifthe bolt has to be removed, fit a new 100 selftapping bolt, engage it manually in the existing thread take care not to create a new thread) then apply a tightening torque of 12 Nm ± 2 Nm

Earth on the gearbox slackened :If the bolt M8x125 is simply slack, retighten by applying a tightening torque of 17 Nm : 3 Nm.


### 6. Specificities : Hybrid vehicles
`peugeot_boxer_en_ccba1fd9` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1816 | doc_type:owners_manual
The harnesses of the 200 V network in hybrid vehicles can be repaired, with the exception of the shielded cable Replacement of the shielded cable is imperative if there is any damage to the cable or its connections.

ESSENTIAL : For the harnesses of the 200 V network, on hybrid vehicles (low voltage range of 50 V to 100, the personnel must have the authorisation according to the type of operation of the publication UTE C 18-550.

If the reworking is carred out by a third party, a contract must be drawn up for the work between the supplier and the company that it employs, before the work is carried out.

ESSENTIAL : All work relating to the connectors and contacts must be carried out by qualified and trained personnel.

The wirer wil take all measures necessary to avoid a change of personnel during the period of quality reworking in the reworking sector.


### 7.1. Wire broken
`peugeot_boxer_en_5c828254` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1817 | doc_type:owners_manual
Apply the following methods in order :

. Method for checking a wire (5.1)   
, Method for stripping a wire (5.3)   
Method for selecting a wire (5.2) (In the case of an unusable wire)   
Method for restoring the covering (5.12)   
Method for selecting a protector (5.13)

ESSENTIAL :If the wire is unusable, cut the wire at the accessible points (near the connectors) and appy section 4.1 observing 2 rules : Remain in the same harness, retain the numbering of the wires (Cut the wire in such a way as to retain the numbered ends).

ESSENTIAL : In the case of a vehicle under warranty, if more than 4 wires are cut, the harness must be replaced.

LUK clutch discs do not have damper hubs.   
The noise generated by the gearbox is fitered by the double damping flywheel (DVA) and not by the clutch disc hub. Gearboxes MLGU6, M40 : The LUK clutch mechanism includes an automatic wear adjustment device that requires a special tool for refitting.

`peugeot_boxer_en_df10f5fb` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1873 | doc_type:owners_manual
Remove the gearbox.

![](images/2ac2a46294c60a3d17002a43c1df7ff2fff8d6863afa6a36a048ab2c9b27d597.webp)

![](images/464c6ea837d14b9c2f183ffcb86f5e527c8e1ede7ebf7132406e507d120385c1.webp)  
Figure : B2BG08ED

Remove the 3 bolts (1) (Every second bolt).   
Position the tools [0217-A] and [0217-B2Z] on the clutch mechanism (2).

CAUTION : Certains volants moteurs comportent des taraudages débouchants. Ne pas faire dépasser les filetages des 3 tiges de maintien lors du vissage; Risque de déformation du volant moteur secondaire.

Screw in the 3 retaining rods [0217-B2Z] in place of the fixing screws (1) ; Ne pas faire dépasser les filetages.

CAUTION : Lors de la compression du mécanisme d'embrayage ; Ne pas franchir de point dur lors du serrage de l vis centrale de l'outil [0217-A]. Le serrage ne doit pas excéder 10 tours dans le sens horaire.

Compress the clutch mechanism (2) with the central bolt of tool [0217-A] (at "a").   
Finish removing the remaining bolts (1).   
Release the clutch mechanism (2) by moving the central bolt of the tool [0217-A] (at "a").   
Remove tools [0217-A] and [0217-B2Z].

Remove :

The clutch mechanism (2) The clutch disc

3. Preparation for removal

3.1. Checking - Cleaning

Visually check :

The flywheel face for damage or scores The flywheel for wear The condition of the starter ring gear , The clutch mechanism (2)

If there is oil in the clutch mechanism (2) :

Contröler I’'état de la bague d'’étanchéité du vilebrequin Contrler 'état de la bague d'étanchéité de l'arbre primaire

CAUTION : Ne pas réutiliser un disque d'embrayage dont le moyeu a des traces d'oxydation ou traces de graisse.

Désoxyder et dégraisser les pièces suivantes ; Using a degreaser Index "N1"  :

The clutch housing   
• The primary shaft   
• The clutch bearing guide (according to equipment)   
• The clutch fork (according to equipment)

N.B. : En cas de corrosion importante, utiliser une brosse métallique sans détériorer les pièces.


### 3.2. Greasing
`peugeot_boxer_en_889dea64` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1874 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : Respecter rigoureusement ’'étape du graissage.

![](images/d5e6a596086b639dbf0ebfe537318f1096c0c8f946660543ec98a5d612d5dc7f.webp)  
Figure : B2BG08FD

CAUTION : Protect the interior of the clutch housing from splashes of grease.

Vehicles equipped with a gearbox that has a mechanical clutch bearing Spray a litte grease MOLYCOTE G-RAPID PLUS (aerosol) on the splines of the primary shaft and on the clutch bearing guide tube  (at "b" and ""). Vehicles equipped with a gearbox that has a hydraulic clutch bearing : Grease the splines of the primary shaft with MOLYCOTE G-RAPID PLUS  (at "").

CAUTION : Ne pas souiller la garniture du disque d'embrayage ; Risque de patinage.

Mettre en place le disque d'embrayage () sur larbre cannelé et effectuer plusieurs translations pour répartir la graisse.   
Déposer le disque d'embrayage .

![](images/b8b09b6adc004f1051c18eaa6b66e72d6eb8e1636305dc40f0bee7dc7f891ea3.webp)  
Figure : B2BG08GD

CAUTION : An excess of grease wil contaminate the clutch friction plate and cause noise in neutral, slipping o juddering of the clutch.

"d" : Traces de graisse présentes sur un disque d'embrayage pollué suite à un surplus de graisse.   
"e" : Traces de graisse présentes sur un carter d’embrayage pollué suite à un surplus de graisse.

| CAUTION : Nettoyer toute trace de graisse susceptible d'tre projetée sur la friction en rotation.

Remove the surplus grease on the top of the grooves and the end of the input shaft using a cloth.

N.B. : La pelicule de graisse déposée sur les éléments en rotation doit ètre la plus fine possible afin d'éviter le projections.

En cas d'impossilité de contrler labsence de friction (disque d'embrayage inaccessile), visser a vis centrale de l'ou [0217-B2Z] de deux tours supplémentaires au maximum.

### BLEEDING : HYDRAULIC CLUTCH CONTROL
`peugeot_boxer_en_910b5d60` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1881 | doc_type:owners_manual
ESSENTIAL : Observe the safety and cleanliness recommendations .

ESSENTIAL : During the bleed operations, take care to maintain the level of brake fluid in the reservoir by topping i up (if necessary). Use new brake fluid only.

CAUTION : Do not use automatic bleed equipment (risk of foaming of the brake fluid in the hydraulic circuit).

N.B. : For the bleed operation 2 operators are necessary.

Chock and lift the vehicle on a 2 column lift.

![](images/038cfa36fe2c0cb8a07b7060cafc61d2ba8506c7ba408af56a88106a0bc73b00.webp)  
Figure : B2BI00JD

Couple a transparent pipe onto the bleed valve (1).   
Sink the end of the transparent tube in a container containing brake fluid, located lower down than the clutch slave cylinder .

CAUTION : The end of the transparent pipe must be submerged into the brake fluid.

Press the locking clip (2).

Pull the clip (3) by one notch in the direction of the arrow (Position open).   
Action the clutch pedal manually through its entire travel rapidly 7 times.   
Leave the clutch pedal at the lower end of its travel during the last manoeuvre.   
Push back the clip (3) (closed position). Allow the clutch pedal to rise to the upper position.   
Fill the brake fluid reservoir to its maximum capacity.   
Press the locking clip (2).   
Pull the clip (3) by one notch in the direction of the arrow (Position open).   
Action the clutch pedal manually through its entire travel rapidly 7 times.   
Keep the clutch pedal at the lower end of its travel during the last manoeuvre.   
Push back the clip (3) (Closed position).   
Uncouple the transparent pipe.   
Top up the brake fluid level to the MAX. level in the brake fluid reservoir.   
Press the clutch pedal rapidly 40 times.   
Lower the vehicle.   
Start the engine.   
Apply the handbrake.   
Engage a gear. Check that clutch mechanism friction begins at a dimension "A" of 40 mm or more (the dimension (A) is given as a guide).   
Repeat the bleed operations (if necessary).

`peugeot_boxer_en_144aa19b` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1912 | doc_type:owners_manual
The absence of an oil leak at the stop guide and at the crankshaft seal The state of wear of the clutch

Rectify (if necessary).

JUMPER II - B2CGBZPO - Removing - refiting : Manual gearbox (Type MLGU)

N.B. : Clean the primary shaft and the stop guide by hand using a metal brush in order to eliminate alltraces o oxidation.

ESSENTIAL : Clean the input shaft completely along its entire length, over its entire periphery and in the grooves.

Protect the interior of the clutch housing from splashes of grease.   
Spray the recommended lubricant evenly onto the thrust guide and the primary shaft.   
Grease the fingers of the clutch fork .

N.B. : For these operations, use the product MOLYKOTE SPRAY RAPIDE (Aerosol).

Remove the surplus grease on the top of the grooves and the end of the input shaft using a cloth.

CAUTION : An excess of grease wil contaminate the clutch friction plate and cause noise in neutral, slipping o juddering of the clutch.

ESSENTIAL : If the clutch disc is reused, the disc hub must be free of traces of oxidation.

On refitting, the clutch stop must be on its guide and positioned by the clutch release fork.   
Place the gear lever in neutral.

Refit :

The gearbox ; Using the component lift The engine gearbox coupling bolts

Raise the engine-gearbox assembly ; Using the transverse engine support bar.   
Move aside the component lift .

### 1. Check: air conditioning compressor
`peugeot_boxer_en_0857d225` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1941 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : Before carrying out any work on the air conditioning compressor, top up the air conditioning circuit charge If the air conditioning circuit failure persists : Make the following checks.


### 1.1. Preliminary checks
`peugeot_boxer_en_1f53ff0a` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1942 | doc_type:owners_manual
Visually check : The air-conditioning compressor :

Check that the frame has not suffered any knocks and that it is not distorted   
Check that the pulley has not suffered any knocks or bangs   
Check that the clutch engages when the coil is supplied with 12V   
Check the condition of the supply cable and of the connector   
Check that the body of the air conditioning compressor is not cracked (at the air conditioning compressor fixing   
points)   
Check that the air conditioning compressor intake and discharge ports are not damaged

![](images/e871954c9c4116fb4b4babe4e95b8e3cbdb6bfdf7ae6e4493d5ac160f367c6ec.webp)

![](images/20b4bf8cc379f794c2017891ee68c07e3841b621f980cf0de22c2ae605ab2007.webp)

Interpretations of the pressures measured in the air conditioning circuit (Vehicle stationary, engine running)

![](images/ada363fc8e11e4e058ee8ef7fddcc76b3690e7c51f3694b75d824d616d591cfe.webp)

UMPER II - C5HB012VP0 - Technical note : Check of the air conditioning circui   
![](images/880470b691d77cc60e1114fb940a406e1f3d66eecfa8d0094041708b9b3133d1.webp)


### 1.2. Check with tool
`peugeot_boxer_en_f9a879cd` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1943 | doc_type:owners_manual
Check the air conditioning compressor (The recommended tools should be used).

N.B. : See instructions for use : Tooling .


### 1.3. Oil level check
`peugeot_boxer_en_119f7e4a` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1944 | doc_type:owners_manual
ESSENTIAL : The compressor lubricant is extremely hygroscopic, use new fluid for any operation.

There are 3 different cases :

Repairs to a system that has no leaks   
Slow leak   
Rapid leak

1.4. Work on the circuit (Without leak)

Use of filling and recycling equipment not fited with an oil trap :

Drain the low pressure fluid circuit as slowly as possible to prevent the compressor oil from being drawn out of th system   
The circuit is filled with refrigerant without the addition of oil

Use of filling and recycling equipment fitted with an oil trap :

Drain the refrigerant circuit conforming to the instructions in the equipment's manual   
Measure the quantity of oil recovered   
Add the same quantity of oil as that recovered


### 1.5. Slow leak
`peugeot_boxer_en_5d4538ad` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1945 | doc_type:owners_manual
Slight leaks do not cause losses of oil, apply the procedure described for repairs to a system without leaks.


### 1.6. Rapid leak
`peugeot_boxer_en_57ed5d37` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1946 | doc_type:owners_manual
This type of incident can produce a loss of oil, as well as cause the circuit to breathe.

Perform the following operations :

Replace the filtering and drying cartridge (If necessary) Evacuate the maximum amount of oil possible (when replacing the faulty component) Before or during the R134.a refrigerant refilling process, introduce 80 cc of new oil into the system


### 2. Air conditioning system check
`peugeot_boxer_en_c2d334cc` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1947 | doc_type:owners_manual
Fit the tool in its place(Tools recommended in the Service documentation ). Perform the following operations :

Close all the air vents Start the engine Open the front left vent Select the central and side air vents on the air conditioning control panel Position the air circulation control on "entry of exterior air" Set the A/C system to the maximum ventilation setting Reduce the temperature as much as possible   
− Operate the air conditioning for 5 minutes


### 3. Interpretation of the values (reminder)
`peugeot_boxer_en_13b38bc6` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1948 | doc_type:owners_manual
N.B. : Values relating to use of the diagnostic tool.


### 3.1. Undercooling (SR)
`peugeot_boxer_en_e775c1dd` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1949 | doc_type:owners_manual
The under-cooling represents the difference between the condensation temperature and the refrigerant temperature a he air conditioning condenser outlet.

The under-cooling indicates the quantity of refrigerant (in liquid state) in the air conditioning circuit.

![](images/38cf1c1111e3947bb1250b67e38136a30bf6abec56d1ac1aa42dcfab204799c8.webp)

UMPER II - C5HB012VPO - Technical note : Check of the air conditioning circui

![](images/8afc5f11b76aa82d36ee9033f18666b39425c5fd20c1636b5a69dab738593567.webp)


### 3.2. Over-heating
`peugeot_boxer_en_a56695d3` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1950 | doc_type:owners_manual
The over-heating represents the diference between the refrigerant temperature at the evaporator outlet and the evaporation temperature.

The over-heating indicates the quantity of refrigerant (in gaseous state) in the air conditioning circuit.

![](images/6902e4032d9ad3e0cfe53cbfde2ef7c68e104460c3181e57c734556e8d3011da.webp)


### 3.3. Temperature of the blown air "u"
`peugeot_boxer_en_4ca0dbcc` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1951 | doc_type:owners_manual
The temperature of the blown air should be between 2°C and 10°C.

`peugeot_boxer_en_7aa43cea` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1958 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : Observe the tightening torque values  .

CAUTION : Never fit an air-conditioning compressor that has suffered an impact.

CAUTION : Check the cleanliness of the ducts up and downstream of the air conditioning compressor.

CAUTION : Put in place new O-ring seal ; Oil the seals with air conditioning compressor oil.

CAUTION : Drain the new compressor ①; Put in the quantity of oil measured at removal.

UMPER IIC5HG01B3PO - Removing - Reftting : Air conditioning compressor

The 3 air-conditioning compressor fixing bolts (3)

Refit the 2 bolts (1).

Connect the connector (at "a").

Refit the ancillary belt .

Using the charging station :

Vacuum drain the air conditioning system (For 15 minutes minimum) Check the sealing (Refrigeration system)

Refit the under-engine protection .

Using the charging station :

Vacuum drain the air conditioning system (For 35 minutes minimum) Charge the air conditioning circuit

Return the vehicle to its wheels.

CAUTION : Perform the operations to be carried out following reconnection of the battery.

Reconnect the battery.

CAUTION : The first time the air conditioning compressor is started, do not exceed 1500 rpm for the first minute i order to distribute the oil in the air conditioning circuit.

Check the operation of the air conditioning .

CAUTION : Replace the torsional vibration damper double pulley for a distance travelled greater than or equal t 160000 km, when the accessories drive belt is replaced.

Place the vehicle on a 2-post lift.   
Disconnect the battery negative terminal.

Remove :

The protection plates under the engine The front right wheel

CAUTION : Prior to removal, and before any subsequent refittig of the ancillary drive belt that has been removed, it is compulsory for the engine to be at ambient temperature (Below 0 C). In alother cases, replace the ancillay drive belt.

N.B. : Removing it with the engine hot causes irreversible and invisible damage to the ancillary drive belt.

CAUTION : If replacing it, cut and remove the ancillary drive belt.

CAUTION : Check that the tool [0198-P] is correctly positioned between two teeth of the flywheel; or turn the crankshaft to correctly position the tool.

Move aside and secure : The starter motor  .

• The silentblock (7)   
• The washer (6)   
The nut (5) Couple up the steering balljoint (2) (on each side).

16 inch wheels : 18 ± 2,4 daNm

ESSENTIAL : Keep the temperature of the glass under control to prevent i from breaking.

Mixing 5 litres of distilled water with the dose provided permits several repairs of optimum quality. If the polisher bounces on the glass during the operation, increase the level of water and the angle of the polisher slightly.

Separate the fabric from the foam (Approx. 10 mm around the hole "a") ; Using pliers (Tweezers).

JUMPER III - C5GM0103P0 - Repair : Seat trim

Cut a piece out of the backing fabric (1), somewhat bigger than the hole "a" to be repaired.   
Make a mark in the centre of the piece of backing fabric (1).

CAUTION : The mark must be at the centre of the hole to enable you to position the fabric centrally.

Put the piece of backing fabric (1) in place.

![](images/d75b7bd074ccde04fa5a16c990170e4201a3cc7c06e08f7743cd7b0ad73b5ff3.webp)  
Figure : C5GM1E4D

Apply the backing fabric with the tweezers and hold it in position.

With the spatula, take some powder adhesive.   
Apply the adhesive on the edges only.

2 R 2 D E E 2 F

N.B. : Prepare the smoothing iron to the temperature indicated by the supplier ; See instructions for use.

Remove the teflon and then use the smoothing iron to stick down the edges around the hole,taking the time indicated b the supplier.

CAUTION : Quickly inspect the repair after the initial heating to make sure that the adhesive is not drying around the hole.

REPAIR : SEAT TRIM (LEATHER)

ESSENTIAL : Observe the safety and cleanliness recommendations .

CAUTION : Follow the user instructions in the seat trim repair kit.

1. Tooling Equipment : Seat trim repair kit.

2. Preparing the zone to be repaired

![](images/aeeb6d30a17c0ee368bff553fca0aec50d424bf6f2eac203a7393a96680cc94d.webp)  
Figure : C5GM1ERD

Clean the zone to be repaired using the degreaser provided in the repair kit.

![](images/491c4ac071b34d5d11cefc22b968bb062bc3585e1160186c6c80695c4bcb4ff5.webp)  
Figure : C5GM1EUD

Uniformly spread the product provided in the repair kit ; Using the adhesive knife.   
Allow to dry for 20 minutes or accelerate the drying using a heat source.   
Take away the moulding (1). Degrease using the degreaser included in the repair kit.   
Allow to dry.   
Trim the edges of the hole ; Using scissors.   
Use the tweezers to separate the leather from the foam.

![](images/4e949555941698ba9d8ad0f2539207dd53be8fc630748851706bf6c12c66b21b.webp)  
Figure : C5GM1EXD

![](images/437a2ed2076aa72a7b32688854cb9d730ba082ed9479220d17db354428af5865.webp)  
Figure : C5GM1FOD

Cut the piece of backing fabric (2) into a rounded overlapping shape.

![](images/6dd85555066f4f4d278ebda805cc23cdfbc3c9c3d90b49795115eb3f0a198909.webp)  
Figure : C5GM1F3D

Make a mark in the centre of the piece of backing fabric (2) (at "a").

![](images/567214fce8f5da5a7f7072825600eb7cb4257bbd40512557e518a17005ff6685.webp)  
Figure : C5GM1F6D

N.B. : Make sure that the mark on the backing fabric is at the centre of the hole (Make sure that the fabric is extende flat underneath the leather).

Put the piece of backing fabric (2) in place ; Using either the tweezers or the adhesive knife.


### 3. Applying the liquid leather

![](images/b66c18f50cb365b5ba2be773e189c25d75264badd1fb0178725100cf689afcee.webp)

![](images/05c8b9113628e7344493a2c7a6aefd9f0bad238bfb079fb74dc9c5a8bf0449e9.webp)  
Figure : C5GM1FCD

Pre-heat the iron to position 2,5.   
Use the teflon sheet provided, to go between the leather and the iron.   
Use the heat to make the liquid leather stick to the backing fabric.

N.B. : Repeat the operation of applying liquid leather to make it flush with the hole.

Remove any excess of liquid leather on the outer surface.

### 4. Re-assembling
`peugeot_boxer_en_323298a6` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2097 | doc_type:owners_manual
ESSENTIAL : Always replace the damaged fixings.

Carry out the re-trim operations in the reverse order to the stripping operations. Tighten :

The nuts (5) to 2 ± 0,4 daN.m The bolts (17) to 2 ± 0,4 daN.m   
The bolts (4), (8), (10), (13), (16), (25), (37), (52) to 4,2 ± 0,8 daN.m The bolts (64), (66) to 5,3 ± 0,7 daN.m   
The nuts (14) to 4,3 ± 0,8 daN.m

Check all the equipment works.

ESSENTIAL : Observe the safety and cleanliness recommendations.

The parts replaced will be deployed in the following cases :

Parts to be destroyed Parts which have passed their validity date

`peugeot_boxer_en_a126a14c` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2125 | doc_type:owners_manual
The packaging recovered from the replacement part must be used to transport the parts.

5. Repairability of the harness

The repair of all of the harnesses is permitted using strictly RAYCHEM welded unions observing the operating procedure.   
Compulsory method of repair : Equipment (RAYCHEM).

ESSENTIAL : Repair of the wires must be carried out with heat shrink sleeves and outer covers (-).1228 kit).

Replace the generator connecting harness if the connector is damaged following triggering.   
In the case of a module supplied with a harness, the whole will be replaced.

CAUTION : Replace the torsional vibration damper double pulley for a distance travelled greater than or equal t 160000 km, when the accessories drive belt is replaced.

Place the vehicle on a 2-post lift.   
Disconnect the battery negative terminal.

Remove :

The protection plates under the engine The front right wheel

CAUTION : Prior to removal, and before any subsequent refittig of the ancillary drive belt that has been removed, it is compulsory for the engine to be at ambient temperature (Below 0 C). In alother cases, replace the ancillay drive belt.

N.B. : Removing it with the engine hot causes irreversible and invisible damage to the ancillary drive belt.

CAUTION : If replacing it, cut and remove the ancillary drive belt.

CAUTION : Check that the tool [0198-P] is correctly positioned between two teeth of the flywheel; or turn the crankshaft to correctly position the tool.

Move aside and secure : The starter motor  .

N.B. : Return the vehicle to its wheels.

Engine stopped :

Fill the power steering fluid reservoir to the maximum level (If necessary) Turn the steering in both directions, from lock to lock (3 times minimum) •Top up the power steering fluid to the maximum level (If necessary)

engine running :

Wait one minute Top up the power steering fluid to the maximum level (If necessary) Move the steering from lock to lock, until there is no point of resistance

Stop the engine.   
Top up the power steering fluid to the maximum level.   
Check there are no leaks.

CAUTION : The suspension components of the rear axle must be tightened with the vehicle at the reference height Failure to observe these conditions would result in the distortion of the silent blocks or an ineficient tightening of the suspension blade clamps.

Disconnect the battery negative terminal.   
Untighten the wheel screws (left hand front).   
Lift and support the front of the vehicle.   
Remove the left-hand front wheel. Remove the nut (1) (left side).   
Uncouple the steering balljoint (2) ; Using tool [1].

Move the hub carrier forward. Remove (on each side) :

Remove the nuts (3), (5) • The washer (6) The silentblock (7) The connecting rod (8)

### N.B. : Always fit new Nylstop nuts.
`peugeot_boxer_en_a7e8620c` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2298 | doc_type:owners_manual
Refit (on each side) :

The front anti-roll bar (10)   
The bolts (9) ; Tighten to 5 ± 1,3 daN.m   
The connecting rod (8)   
The silentblock (7)   
The washer (6)   
The nuts (5), (3)   
Position the hub carrier lower ball joint.   
Refit the bolts (4) ; Tighten to 11,5 ± 0,4 daN.m.   
Couple up the steering ball-joint (2).   
Refit the nut (1) ; Tighten to 8 ± 0,7 daN.m.   
Fit the wheel.   
Return the vehicle to its wheels.   
Tighten (on each side) : The nut (3) to 5,6 ± 0,5 daN.m The nut (5) to 5,6 ± 0,5 daN.m

`peugeot_boxer_en_88adce77` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2344 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : Always fit new Nylstop nuts.

Place the rear axle under the vehicle ; Using tool [1].

Refit :

The rear axle The bolts (7), (8)

Refit dampers upper fixing (5).

ESSENTIAL : Before carrying out the final tightening of fixings (5), (6), (7), (8), the vehicle MUST be placed at the load setting height.

Remove the tools [1], [2].

Refit (on each side) :

The brake caliper (2) The bolt (1) (new) Pre-coated with a thread-locking product

Tighten the bolt (1) to 3 ± 0,3 daN.m.   
Fit the brake pads (see the relevant operation).   
Couple the handbrake cables at the compensator (4).   
Fit the handbrake sleeves in their housing (at "c, "d").   
Adjust The handbrake cables (see the relevant operations). Reconnect the wheel sensor connector " b " (on each side).   
Clip the wheel sensor harness on the body (on each side).   
Return the spare wheel to its place.   
Refit the rear wheels.   
Return the vehicle to its wheels.   
Before carrying out the final tightening of fixings , the vehicle MUST be placed at the load setting heght (see the relevar operation).

Tighten :

The bolts (5), (6), (7) to 14,5 ± 1,2 daN.m The bolts (8) to 18,5 ± 2,9 daN.m

The protective panel under the engine The right-hand protector under the engine   
. The front wheel bolts   
The front wheels

Figure : B3FP7NJD

2.1. On the left-hand side Remove the driveshaft . 2.2. On the right-hand side

CAUTION : Always replace the driveshaft seals during each operation (see the relevant operation).

Coat the interval between the lips of the driveshaft seals with grease.

3.1. On the right-hand side

Engage :

The driveshaft in the driveshaft bearing The splines of the driveshaft in the differential The splines of the driveshaft in the hub of the right-hand wheel

3.2. On the left-hand side

The splines of the driveshaft in the differential The splines of the driveshaft in the hub of the left-hand wheel


### 3.3. Refitting (continued)
`peugeot_boxer_en_aea9c4a7` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2364 | doc_type:owners_manual
Couple the ball joint housing (8) and the hub .

Refit :

The 3 bolts (9) ; Tighten to 11,5 ± 0,4 daN.m   
• The silentblock (6)   
The washer (5)

The nut (4) ; Tighten to 5,6 ± 0,5 daN.m

Retighten the nut (7) ; Tighten to 5,6 ± 0,5 daN.m.

N.B. : Use new nuts (3) and (1).

Couple the steering ball joint (2) to the hub .

Refit :

The nut (3) ; Tighten to 8 ± 0,7 daN.m   
The tool [6310-T]   
The nut (1) ; Tighten to 15 ± 1,5 daN.m ; Angular tightening to 35° Lock the transmission nut using the tool [5709-T.E].   
The flat side "a"of the tool [5709-T.E] must always be towards the outside.

![](images/3d1a0f76cd421dc6a3489f7cc1fd3de17025c24bae8ed6f11d3c6a4f8bc40166.webp)  
Figure : B2FG039D

ESSENTIAL : The nut collar must be locked in the opposite direction to tightening.

Remove the tool [6310-T].

Refit :

The front wheels • The front wheel bolts The right-hand protector under the engine The protective panel under the engine

Return the vehicle to its wheels.   
Tighten the front wheel bolts  .   
Fill gearbox with oil and ensure correct level (see the relevant operation).

CAUTION : Perform the operations to be carried out following reconnection of the battery.

### 1. recommendations
`peugeot_boxer_en_6d6d085b` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2375 | doc_type:owners_manual
CAUTION : The use of impact wrenches to refit the wheel bolts and wheel anti-theft bolts is strictly prohibited.

CAUTION : The wheels are always tightened with dry bolts.

CAUTION : When installing a new steel wheel for the first time, Always double tighten the wheel, to avoid any risk o slackening.

N.B. : Double tightening consists of tightening to the specified torque followed by slackening then retightening to the specified torque.

Ensure that the anti-theft wrench is positioned correctly on refitting.

CAUTION : Tighten the wheel bolts using a torque wrench.


### 2. Tightening torques : road wheels

### 3. Wheel valve
`peugeot_boxer_en_23c911b8` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2377 | doc_type:owners_manual
3.1. Vehicles not equipped with tyre under-inflation detection system Always replace the wheel valves when changing the tyres.

CAUTION : Vehicles DS3 Racing ; Tighten the wheel valves to 0,4 daNm.

3.2. Vehicles fitted with a tyre under-inflation detection system Observe the tightening torque of the wheel valve nuts : Tighten to 0,8 daN.m.

ESSENTIAL : Observe the safety and cleanliness recommendations.


### 1. Removing
`peugeot_boxer_en_3aa4a6ca` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:2378 | doc_type:owners_manual
Disconnect the battery.   
Put the wheels in the straight ahead position.

### 1. Removing
`peugeot_boxer_en_0cf99858` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:2383 | doc_type:owners_manual

![](images/df78b13301484cfe025553778c050641618c44c0898f8a623b3977f94b41e941.webp)  
Figure : C5DP06VD

Disconnect the connector "a".   
Unclip the spring ( 2).   
Extract the rain sensor ( 1) from its base by hand (perpendicular to the windscreen).


### 2.Refitting
`peugeot_boxer_en_38374746` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2384 | doc_type:owners_manual
ESSENTIAL : Fit a new rain sensor.

N.B. : The cleanliness of the rain sensor and of the windscreen are essential for the correct operation of the system.

Clean the windscreen and the inside of the base of alldirt, bonding residue and other particles; using a non-fluffy pap towel and glass detergent.

CAUTION : Chemical detergents are not authorised.

Remove the protection cover.

CAUTION : Do not touch the contact surface with the skin or with any object.

Place the rain sensor ( 1) in its base.   
Lock the spring ( 2).   
Connect the connector "a".


### 3. Checks
`peugeot_boxer_en_743635f9` | boxer | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2385 | doc_type:owners_manual
Insert the key in the vehicle ignition.   
Start the engine.   
Activate the automatic windscreen wipe (position I or "AUTO").   
A single wipe of the front windscreen confirms that the automatic mode has been activated.   
Spray water onto the rain sensor zone.   
Check the functioning of the automatic windscreen wipe.   
Place the wiper switch in position 0.   
Stop the engine.
